errors.text: The hypothesis retains thermodynamic integration, whereas the target's central efficiency innovation is replacing thermodynamic integration with free-energy perturbation using an MTP closely matched to DFT.
It makes CALPHAD the screening backbone rather than reconstructing the DFT-based free-energy workflow and its MTP-for-liquid substitution.
It omits the electronic Gibbs free-energy contribution and associated density-of-states feature, which are essential to the target melting-temperature shifts.
The claimed ±5% accuracy is unsupported by the cited evidence, which only establishes broad motivation for refractory alloys and extreme-temperature applications.
